title: Customer Care Advisor

title: Customer Service Advisor
description: Customer Service Advisor Paying 26k - 28k DOE Based in Manchester City 5 days on site We're looking for a confident, motivated and commercially minded Customer Service professional to join a fast-paced and supportive credit control team. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working with people, is comfortable having conversations around customer payments and arrears, and takes pride in achieving results without compromising on customer service. You'll take ownership of your own portfolio of clients, working closely with colleagues across the business to resolve queries, manage accounts and maximise cash collection. You'll also have the opportunity to make a real impact on the wider performance of the credit control function. What you'll be doing - Managing your own daily collection schedule and taking responsibility for achieving individual targets. - Making outbound collection calls, with telephone contact being the preferred first point of contact. - Working towards and exceeding agreed KPIs and SLAs across cash collection and customer contact. - Managing outstanding balances and supporting the rescheduling of arrears where appropriate. - Monitoring account activity and aged debt, identifying trends and taking action where required. - Escalating account queries where they require further support or fall outside your remit. - Building strong relationships with internal stakeholders to ensure issues are dealt with quickly and professionally. - Contributing to a positive team environment and supporting colleagues when needed. - Identifying any areas where additional training or coaching would be beneficial. - Keeping on top of activity levels, including calls, call time and email queues, and being able to explain any significant changes or variances in performance. What we're looking for You'll ideally have previous experience in Credit Control, Collections, Customer Service or a customer-facing environment. More importantly, you'll be someone who: - Is confident, positive and an excellent communicator. - Is comfortable speaking to customers about payments and resolving difficult conversations professionally. - Has strong negotiation and influencing skills. - Takes ownership of their workload and is accountable for their results. - Works well under pressure and enjoys working in a busy, changing environment. - Is target-driven but understands the importance of delivering a great customer experience. - Is reliable, punctual and committed to maintaining high standards. What success looks like You'll play an important role in the overall performance of the credit function, with success measured across areas including: - Cash collection and collection efficiency. - Reduction and movement of aged debt. - Debtor days. - Rescheduling of arrears. - Direct Debit coverage. - Outbound call activity. - Achievement of agreed KPIs and SLAs. - Quality of customer interactions and resolution of queries. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys a role where no two days are quite the same, likes being measured on results and wants to be part of a team where their contribution genuinely matters. 52301 CH INDMANJ The Portfolio Group are acting on behalf of our client in recruiting for this position.

title: Customer Service Advisor

We want our people to feel that they belong and can be their best, regardless of background, identity, or culture. We were one of the first major organisations to set goals on diversity in senior roles, create a menopause health package, and a dedicated Working with Cancer initiative. And it's why we especially welcome applications from under-represented groups. We're disability confident. So, if you'd like reasonable adjustments to be made to our recruitment processes, just let us know. If you're excited by the thought of becoming part of our team, get in touch. We'd love to hear from you!

title: Customer Service Advisor
description: Customer Service Advisor Manchester Full-time If a customer has a problem, you'll own it until it's sorted. We're looking for a Customer Service Advisor to join a small, experienced and genuinely dedicated customer service team within an established consumer products business. This isn't a high-volume call centre role, and it isn't about getting somebody off the phone as quickly as possible. You'll deal with enquiries and complaints from both retail customers and members of the public, taking responsibility from the initial contact right through to resolution. Sometimes the answer will be straightforward. Sometimes you'll need to investigate, speak to other departments, chase information and find a practical solution. Either way, the important thing is that you care about getting it right. What You'll Be Doing - Handling customer enquiries by phone and email - Managing complaints from initial contact through to resolution - Supporting both retail customers and members of the public - Investigating delivery, product, order and general customer issues - Liaising with Sales, Logistics, Stock Control and other internal teams - Keeping customers updated rather than leaving them wondering what's happening - Maintaining accurate records of conversations and agreed actions - Following issues through until they are properly resolved - Spotting recurring problems and helping prevent them happening again What We're Looking For More than anything, we're looking for the right type of person. Someone who is patient, conscientious and takes pride in doing a good job. You'll ideally have: - Previous customer service experience - A genuine desire to help customers and solve problems - Excellent attention to detail - A calm and professional manner - Good written and verbal communication skills - The confidence to deal with complaints and occasionally frustrated customers - The persistence to follow something through rather than simply passing it on - Good IT and administration skills - A reliable, team-focused approach You don't need to be looking for the next promotion every 12 months. This could particularly suit someone who wants to join a good team, become really good at their job and be valued for doing it well. The Team You'll be joining a small, well-established customer service team where people work together, know their customers and take pride in the service they provide. If you're naturally helpful, organised and you're the sort of person who hates leaving a problem half-solved, we'd like to hear from you. Apply now for more information. Coburg Banks Limited is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy.
